description: This file implements environment variable management, string expansion, and function handling for a build configuration system, including parsing and evaluating expressions, environment variable tracking, and built-in functions.

methods.name: env_add
methods.description: Adds a new environment variable to the list.

methods.name: env_del
methods.description: Removes an environment variable from the list.

methods.name: env_expand
methods.description: Expands an environment variable by name, including tracking referenced variables.

methods.name: env_write_dep
methods.description: Writes environment variable dependencies to a file.

methods.name: variable_lookup
methods.description: Looks up a variable by name.

methods.name: variable_add
methods.description: Adds or updates a variable with specified flavor.

methods.name: eval_clause
methods.description: Evaluates a clause with arguments, returning a string.

methods.name: expand_dollar_with_args
methods.description: Expands a dollar expression with arguments.

methods.name: expand_string_with_args
methods.description: Expands variables and functions in a string with arguments.

methods.name: expand_string
methods.description: Expands variables and functions in a string.
